note: Both sets capture the core Table 4-1 values, the 0.170 Hz first tower-monopile mode, the 30 m clearance with 120-m blades, and the 0.10–0.13 Hz wave range, and both are padded with many duplicate claims and both misread the figure line as 0.18 Hz. Set B does add two important facts A omits (150 m hub height, 10-m monopile outer diameter), but it introduces more serious numeric errors (793E3 Pa, 793E10 Pa, 785E3 kg/m3) plus an unsupported 0.12 Hz JONSWAP peak value whose quote does not support it. Set A's faults are milder (one garbled density 785E3 kg/m^5, the 0.18 Hz figure read, and soil properties bound/labeled as tower material), so A is the more faithful set overall despite its coverage gap.
